title: Blueberry Pie Bars
changes_from_base: Brown sugar shortbread base and crumble with a lemony spiced blueberry filling instead of caramel and chocolate.
summary: Shortbread crust and crumble with a thick, lemony blueberry filling.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Crust
steps.text: Heat the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan) and line the large tin. Mix the flour, both sugars and salt, then stir in the melted butter until pea-sized clumps form. Set aside about 40% (roughly 450 g) for the crumble and chill it.

steps.title: Prebake
steps.text: Press the rest firmly over the base of the tin and bake 18-20 min, until set and just browning at the edges. Cool 15 min.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Put the blueberries, sugar, cornflour, zest, coriander and cinnamon in a large pan and bring to a simmer, then cook 4-5 min on medium-low, mashing some berries, until thick and bubbling. Stir in the lemon juice and cool 30 min.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread the filling over the crust and crumble the reserved mixture over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 45-55 min, turning halfway, until the crumble is golden and the filling bubbles at the edges.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool at least 2 h in the tin before lifting out and cutting into 24.

tips: Cook the filling until you can see the bottom of the pan when stirring.
Frozen blueberries work; cook a few minutes longer.
Cool fully so the filling sets for clean cuts.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for 2 days or in the fridge for up to 4 days.
